title: The Christian content you're creating may be getting attention... but is it changing lives?
paragraphs: The Christian content you're creating may be getting attention... but is it changing lives?
Views are easy to chase.
Likes are easy to celebrate.
But transformed hearts?
That's a different mission.
Too many Christians spend more time studying algorithms than studying God's Word.

We polish our posts...
Perfect our thumbnails...
Optimize our captions...
...yet forget that the greatest content strategy begins with prayer, sound doctrine, and pointing people to Jesus.
If you've ever wondered:
"How can I create Bible content that truly impacts lives?"
This new book was written for you.
How to Create Bible Content That Changes Lives
This isn't another social media marketing guide.
It's a practical, Bible-centered roadmap for Christian creators who want every post, video, article, sermon, devotional, or book to faithfully proclaim Christ and encourage genuine discipleship.
Inside this powerful guide you'll discover:
✅ How to create Bible content rooted in Scripture—not trends
✅ How to communicate truth with both conviction and compassion
✅ The biggest mistakes Christian creators make (and how to avoid them)
✅ How to write, teach, and create content that points people to Jesus—not yourself
✅ Biblical principles for using books, reels, devotionals, podcasts, blogs, and social media for God's glory
✅ How to measure success by faithfulness instead of followers
🔥 MOST PEOPLE vs FEW PEOPLE
Most people want to go viral.
Few people want to be biblically faithful.
Most people build a personal brand.
Few people build God's Kingdom.
Most people chase influence.
Few people make disciples.
Which one do you want to become?
🎁 And more as our library continues to grow
It's a movement of Christians committed to creating content that is:
✝️ Christ-centered
📖 Biblically faithful
❤️ Full of grace and truth
🌍 Focused on changing lives—not just growing audiences
👑 READY TO BE PART OF THE MISSION?
If you're serious about honoring God with your gifts...
If you want your content to point people to Jesus...
